verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a Secure Cloud (Datacenter) tier. Machines in it are verified to be in datacenters with a Tier 2/3 rating or ISO 27001 and carry a blue label, so an engineer can filter for certified datacenter hosts. That covers the datacenter-tier part of the story. The evidence shows nothing on Vast.ai's own SOC 2 attestation or its data-handling policies, and a community report of a host misrepresenting its location lowers confidence in marketplace trust signals. missing for 10: SOC 2 report/attestation, documented data-handling/privacy policies for customer models and data, trust center or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of datacenter verification.
